English: Rope Pen
A humble enclosure of rope and stakes, hastily erected to keep livestock from wandering on the open steppe.
Wattle Sheepfold
A basic pen of woven reeds and wattle, providing better protection for sheep and goats against predators and the elements.
Goat Paddock
A larger, sturdier paddock of timber rails and brush, suitable for housing a growing herd of goats and sheep.
Pig Enclosure
A fenced, dug-out yard designed for hardier livestock like pigs, with simple feeding troughs and mud wallows.
Expanded Livestock Yard
A broad, subdivided yard with multiple pens and covered shelters, supporting diverse herds and improved animal management.
Multi-Animal Stockade
A fortified enclosure of timber and earth, partitioned for various animals, with basic security against theft and predators.
Tended Animal Corral
A well-managed corral with herder shacks, improved fencing, and dedicated tending staff, maximizing herd health and productivity.
Breeding Shed
A specialized facility for controlled breeding, with select animals, stabling, and record-keeping for herd improvement.
Animal Market Pen
A bustling livestock market yard with auction enclosures, trade facilities, and space for visiting merchants.
Nomad Menagerie
A grand, mobile menagerie showcasing prized livestock and rare breeds, symbolizing the wealth and prestige of the clan.
